top_signal.title: Welcome to my pity party...
top_signal.summary: Welcome to My Pity Party 🎉 (Where We Complain, Then Help Each Other Get Unstuck)    Hey everyone. Long-time listener, first-time caller. :)   Most entrepreneurial groups are full of "You've got this!" and "Keep going!" And while that's lovely, sometimes encouragement isn't what we need. Sometimes we need someone to say, "Have you tried this?" or "Here's what worked for me." Or even, "I think you're approaching this all wrong." So I'm trying something different. Welcome to My Pity Party.    Here's how it works:    Tell us what's frustrating you about your business or entrepreneurial journey. Keep it relatively short (a few sentences, not your autobiography), but give us enough context to actually help.   End your story with  "Welcome to my pity party."    Then, if you've got experience, ideas, constructive criticism, resources, or connections that might help someone get unstuck, jump in!   The only rule:  No drive-by encouragement.  "You've got this!" is nice, but it doesn't help someone who's stuck in the mud. Give them something they can actually use. And don't be afraid to challenge someone's thinking. Just be constructive about it. We're here to help each other move forward, not kick people while they're down.    I'll go first.    I'm a freaking business idea factory. I come up with ideas for myself, my friends, my family, probably the guy standing next to me at the grocery store. And I can build things.
